# Closure Notes

✅ Static preview works by opening index.html.
✅ CSS tokens and component classes are centralized.
✅ Icons are individual transparent SVG files.
✅ HTML snippets are copy/paste ready.
✅ Full HTML templates are included.
✅ React starter component file is included.
